EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S1.title: Define Travel Burden Schema and Contract
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S1.description: Define structured schema for travel distance, duration, units, origin/destination, and routing metadata returned from travel computation, aligned with clinical trial location objects.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S2.title: Implement Travel Distance and Time Computation Logic
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S2.description: Implement core logic to call Google Routes API and compute travel distance and duration between user location and one or more trial sites, including error handling, retries, and null-safe fallback when routing fails.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S3.title: Integrate Travel Burden into Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S3.description: Expose computed travel distance and duration as part of clinical trial results returned by evaluate_care_facade, ensuring consistent formatting and inclusion per trial location.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Travel Burden Computation
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S4.description: Create unit tests for travel calculation logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from trial search to travel burden output, including API failure and partial data scenarios.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S5.title: Multi-Location Aggregation and Selection Logic
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S5.description: Implement logic to handle trials with multiple locations by computing travel for each site and selecting or ranking the nearest option, returning both per-location metrics and a primary (lowest burden) indicator.
